review.assessment: The diff overwrites src/lib.rs with a manual character-by-character scanner that discards hyphens and non-digit characters, failing to parse negative integers as specified. It retains the exact algorithmic flaw called out in the task prompt while missing standard idiomatic patterns like .split(',') and .trim().parse::<i64>(). Consequently, existing tests for positive values pass, but any input containing a leading minus sign will be silently misinterpreted or dropped.

findings.defect: Ignores negative numbers by dropping hyphens.

findings.actual: Manual iteration over s.chars() that explicitly ignores all non-digit/non-comma characters.
findings.defect: Retains manual character scanning instead of using idiomatic split-and-parse logic.
findings.expected: .split(',') combined with .trim().parse::<i64>() or equivalent iterator chain
